hero.title: Your own container. Your own space.
hero.subtitle: Rent your own lockable storage container at our guarded site in District 19, Budapest! We offer a secure place for your valuables, with flexible access and simple rental.

features.title: Why choose Méta Konténer?
features.subtitle: A simple, secure way to store what doesn't fit at home.

items.title: Secure site
items.description: Fenced, camera-monitored and well-lit site where your stored items stay safe.

items.title: Flexible rental
items.description: Rent a container for a short or longer term, whatever your needs require.

items.title: 24/7 access
items.description: For our renters the site is available around the clock, so you can reach your things whenever you need them.

items.title: Weather-protected storage
items.description: Steel containers provide enclosed storage, protecting against rain and the elements.

items.title: Different sizes
items.description: Choose from our 20- and 40-foot containers to find the right size for what you're storing.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.description: Simple, transparent monthly rental fees with no hidden costs.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: Renting a container takes three simple steps.

steps.title: Choose the right size
steps.description: Tell us how much storage space you need, and we'll help you pick the container that fits your needs.

steps.title: Contract and move-in
steps.description: Sign the rental agreement, bring your own padlock, and you can start using the container right away.

steps.title: Store simply and securely
steps.description: Pack your things and use your rented container whenever you need it. We provide 24/7 access, so you can load and unload anytime.

containers.title: Our containers
containers.subtitle: We offer two different container sizes, so you can find the storage space that's right for you.

items.name: 20-foot container
items.description: An ideal choice for storing smaller quantities of goods, furniture, moving items, tools or other belongings.

items.name: 40-foot container
items.description: Also suitable for storing larger quantities of goods, equipment, furniture or a business's stock.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Simple, transparent pricing with no hidden costs.
pricing.note: We provide our containers for both individuals and businesses.

items.question: Who can rent a container?
items.answer: Both individuals and businesses. For businesses, VAT is payable separately.

items.question: What container sizes can I choose from?
items.answer: Our renters can choose between 20- and 40-foot containers.

items.question: How much is the rental fee?
items.answer: 45 000 Ft + VAT/month for the 20-foot and 55 000 Ft + VAT/month for the 40-foot container.

items.question: Is there a deposit?
items.answer: Yes, one month's deposit is required to start the rental.

items.question: When can I access my container?
items.answer: For our renters the site is available 24/7.

items.question: Who provides the padlock?
items.answer: The renter uses their own padlock to lock the container.
